annotation.title_en: European Parliament texts adopted 4 October 2001: amendments on sanctions regulation, general product safety resolution, extraordinary European Council resolution
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 87 E
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt from the Official Journal (C 87 E, 11 April 2002) recording European Parliament texts of 4 October 2001: amendments to a terrorist-funds freezing regulation, approval of the joint text on the general product safety directive, and a resolution on the post-9/11 extraordinary European Council. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament amends the asset-freezing regulation, changing 'expectation' to 'suspicion' and adding a review and expiry date of 31 December 2003.
Parliament approves the Conciliation Committee joint text on the general product safety directive.
Resolution on the extraordinary European Council of 21 September 2001 responding to the 11 September attacks.
